paragraphs: Rabbi Yusti bar Shunam: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot 8:8 (8:7:2 in the linked edition); Sheviit, chapter 1 and 6:1; Midrash Shmuel, chapter 23; Midrash Rabbah, Emor, section 31; Midrash Chazit, on ‘With me from Lebanon, bride.’ Rav Huna transmitted in his name. He asked before Rabbi Mana: Terumot, chapter 11; beginning of Maaser Sheni, chapter 5; Shekalim, chapter 1; Eglah Arufah, halakhah 1; Megillah 1:1.
